topics.topic_name: Symmetric encryption/decryption errors (keys, padding, file/text decoding)
topics.justification: High-weight terms like "key", "encrypt/decrypt", and "padding" point to cipher usage, while "file/read/write", "decode", and "error/wrong/length" suggest troubleshooting encryption/decryption and related byte/text decoding issues.

Dominant words "byte", "string", "character", and "encode/encoding/convert" indicate representation conversions, reinforced by "base64", "binary", "bit", and mentions of "hash"/"salt" commonly needing byte-array and encoding handling.

topics.topic_name: Password hashing implementation and verification (MD5 and checks)
topics.justification: Keywords like "password", "hash", "md5", "generate", "check", and "match" reflect coding patterns for creating and validating password hashes, with "function/method/return" emphasizing implementation details.
